criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Five frames meet the slide bar; the back half falls short: 8 a postcard fence with no dominant subject, 9 reuses frame 3's glass on a dowel with a placeholder phone form, 7 top loaded, 5's stream tiny at 432 px.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine holds; story order explains the sort before the problem; re-sequence declined.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Looser phrasings: frame 6 headline 'already plans the release' stronger than c16 and c17; frame 2's four kinds sits against c23's male only release strain; the 120 cases relay a dashboard not opened.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: No named deciding office, cattle never named on a slide, nothing a rancher can do today.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 5 is the real turn, 7 and 8 both admin.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; 'producers' over ranchers; 'Drawn to illustrate' closes all nine deks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic fresh; one unit per count is the house move.

one_sentence_fix: Give the close something a rancher can act on today and name the deciding office and cattle.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No dominant subject, a thin fence under empty sky.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera low beside the first post so the posts recede from a post filling the left third, type in the sky above the far posts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reuses frame 3's glass on a dowel; the phone's dashed box reads as a placeholder.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Change camera and scale from frame 3; a finished phone screen with no detection drawn.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Top loaded, cubes float on a flat field.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tilt down so the tray fills two thirds and the lifted box is large in the foreground beside its socket.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Generic tub and a speck thin stream at 432 px.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull in so the trap fills half the frame and the stream passes larger through the foreground.
